outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official status records make this a both_fail pair. Serial delivered only 46 patches and passed 37 of 51 listed unit tests, but it did include the axis-ticks-grid-overflow patch. The retained parallel label therefore explains a concrete adverse coordination consequence, not a discordant official outcome.
